cap: 从家门口出发　一路捡起微光
Set off from home, gathering glimmers along the way
爬上樱花树　再撑着叶子飘下来
Climb the cherry tree, then drift down under a leaf
走过湖上的木桥　和青蛙打个招呼
Cross the lake and say hi to the frog
点亮石灯笼　花也跟着开了
Light a lantern, and the flowers bloom
踩一下大蘑菇　就能弹上天
Hop on a mushroom and bounce sky-high
走累了　就坐下来看一会儿雪
Tired? Sit down and watch the snow for a while
五盏灯都亮了　灯塔也醒了
All five lanterns glow, and the lighthouse wakes
